g.text: py-app-sticker-waarschuwing-diefstal | type sticker | trim 140 x 280 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: elf printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: StickerDiefstalARtisDruk.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 140 x 280 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 146 x 286 mm.

Variabelen: heading-nl = Let op!; body-nl-1 = Auto op slot en; body-nl-2 = geen waardevolle; body-nl-3 = spullen achterlaten; heading-en = Please note!; body-en-1 = Lock your car and; body-en-2 = remove all of your; body-en-3 = valuables; callout-text = Verdachte situatie? Bel; phone-number = 0900-8844

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the source has no cut contour. Corner radius 4.2 mm is the radius seen on the footer bar (4.23 mm); to be confirmed by the owner.

White sticker, no background fill: only the footer bar runs into the bottom bleed (template: to the bleed edge, 3 mm; the source overshoots 4.3 mm). All text is navy token #1A3580 (source drifted blue CMYK 100/86.3/21.5/3.5), Ubuntu, centred, leading 1.2: headings Bold 21.17 mm, body Regular 14.11 mm with bold keywords 'op slot', 'geen

waardevolle spullen', 'Lock', 'remove'. Divider navy 1 pt, 127.5 mm. Footer text white 7.76 mm: callout Regular, phone number Bold. The padlock stays light aqua (#68CBDA as sampled, no token).
